record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare FLAME_CHARGE in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats.
record.summary: The caster dashes to the destination returned by Board.getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace and deals SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/120/240 by caster stars) once to every enemy on the cells of the line between its starting cell and that destination. The destination is NOT guaranteed to be next to the farthest enemy: the helper can retain a cell chosen for an earlier, nearer enemy (see positionalConditions). If the line holds no enemy only the cast target is hit; if the helper returns null the caster does not move and only the cast target is hit.

targeting.who: every enemy standing on the cells between the caster and the destination; the destination comes from the helper's scan of targettable enemies, not from the cast target
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true, so a target in range is needed to cast; the target is used only as the fallback victim. isTargettableBy (which enemies count) was not read. The helper's selection rule is described in positionalConditions.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's starting cell to the destination cell chosen by the helper (not necessarily next to the farthest enemy), both endpoints included; the destination is a free cell, so it holds no enemy; the cells are read before the caster moves

effects.target: each distinct enemy on the line (a Set, so one hit per enemy), or only the cast target if none
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's crit reduction) only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after AP/crit, the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; a target with protect / skydiving / magicBounce takes none. The strategy does not read takenDamage.

moveTo(destination, forced displacement false) after the line cells were collected; it swaps the caster with whatever occupies the destination (normally nothing, since the destination is a free cell). The damage is dealt after the move to the enemies collected before it. The destination is next to the farthest enemy only when that enemy had a free adjacent cell; otherwise see positionalConditions.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (240, also the fallback) is not reachable by the units' bare star counts. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: Selection in board.ts:568-630 (same helper as NUZZLE and AQUA_JET): board.forEach scans cells row by row (y outer, x inner); only targettable enemies whose Manhattan distance from the caster is STRICTLY greater than the running maximum are considered, so equal distances keep the first one scanned and enemies up to the running maximum are skipped afterwards. When such an enemy is found the running cell maximum is reset to 0 and its free adjacent cells (getAdjacentCells order) are compared by distance from the caster, the first strictly farther one winning; selectedCell is replaced only when that enemy has at least one free adjacent cell. If it has none, selectedCell is NOT cleared and keeps the cell chosen for an earlier, nearer enemy, whose enemy then counts as the target of the destination. The fallback (the free cell closest by Manhattan distance to the farthest enemy found, anywhere on the board, which may not be adjacent) runs only if selectedCell is still null at the end. Pinned-helper probe on a 6-row x 8-column board, caster (0,0): near enemy (2,0), far enemy (7,5) boxed in by three allies -> destination (3,1) next to the NEAR enemy; far enemy with a free neighbour -> destination (7,4) next to the far enemy; far enemy as the only enemy and boxed in -> fallback cell (7,3). If it returns null (no targettable enemy or no free cell) the caster does not move and only the cast target is hit.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repositions the caster again.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 30/60/120/240 by caster stars. Dealt per enemy = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL SPE_DEF division, the minimum of 1 and the shield step were read
Which enemies are targetable (isTargettableBy) and how the cast target is chosen before the cast
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Movement side effects of swapCells and toMovingState (retargeting after the dash)
unresolved: isTargettableBy was not read, so which enemies can be the farthest target is not established
Whether any item or synergy effect changes FLAME_CHARGE
Units not listed in appliesTo that might share the identifier are not covered

Whether the retained-selection case (a farther enemy with no free adjacent cell) is common on real boards was not examined; the same helper nuance applies to NUZZLE and AQUA_JET. The probe builds the pinned Board methods on a toy layout, not a real fight
